rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an individual coin in everyday Hong Kong speech.

example.english: I found a coin under the sofa.
example.traditional: 我搵到一個銀仔喺梳化底。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 dou2 jat1 go3 ngan4 zai2 hai2 so1 faa2 dai2

rows.note: Use this more formal or neutral term when referring specifically to coins, especially in written or official contexts.

example.english: Please put the coin into the cash box.
example.jyutping: cing2 zoeng1 ngaang6 bai6 tau4 jap6 sau1 ngan4 soeng1
